item.title: Few-layer graphene via cascaded centrifugation
item.description:
Evidence: Well-supported

Liquid-phase exfoliation + stepped centrifuge speeds to sort lateral size/thickness; AFM/Raman report about 5–12 layers.

Source: Scientific Reports

Full week: [[weekly/2026-W38]]

item.title: Water dissociation at graphene vacancies
item.description:
Evidence: Preliminary (preprint, simulation)

Machine-learned potentials show solvation changes how water breaks at a graphene single vacancy: competing acidic and basic paths, not the gas-phase concerted path.

Source: arXiv:2609.11602

Full week: [[weekly/2026-W38]]

Archive file: topics/research/2026-09-10-water-dissociation-graphene-vacancy.md

item.title: Science
item.description:
Papers and measurements. Bodies sit on [[topics/medical|Medical]]. Year pages: [[history|History]]. Named papers also: [[reference/key-papers]].

Established enough to teach

  • 2004 isolation and field effect. [[timeline/2004]]
  • 2005 Dirac fermions and quantum Hall. [[timeline/2005]]
  • Copper CVD film, 2009. [[timeline/2009]]
  • GHz FETs, 2010–11 (f_T, not a phone SoC). [[timeline/2010]] · [[timeline/2011]]
  • Dean 2010 hBN encapsulation. [[timeline/2010]]
  • Britnell 2012 vertical FET; Levendorf 2012 lateral hBN. [[timeline/2012]]
  • Furchi 2012 microcavity photodetector. [[timeline/2012]]
  • Nair 2012 GO membranes (helium-tight, water-fast). [[timeline/2012]]
  • Koenig / Bunch 2012 etched-pore sieve. [[timeline/2012]]
  • 2013 waveguide photodetectors. [[timeline/2013]]
  • Liu 2014 double-layer photodetector; Koppens 2014 review; Cai 2014 THz. [[timeline/2014]]
  • Magic-angle bilayer, Cao 2018. [[timeline/2018]]
  • Vocabulary: ISO/TS 80004-13 (2017, 2024) and 21356-1 (2021). [[reference/iso-vocabulary]]

Did not ship as sold

These were the 2004–12 public pitch. The papers above are real. The products named in that pitch did not arrive as advertised.
